## Walkthrough This PR updates merge automation, routing-table allocation, IPv4/IPv6 forwarding, controller reconciliation, deployment feature flags, EgressIP and KubeVirt tests, MetalLB validation, workload templates, documentation, and OpenShift wiring. ### Changes **Platform behavior and validation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Merge automation filtering**
`.github/scripts/area-merge.js`, `.github/workflows/area-merge.yml`|Merge commands require prefix matching, bot comments are ignored, and bot identity is configurable.| |**Routing and forwarding configuration**
`go-controller/pkg/config/*`, `go-controller/pkg/node/*`, `go-controller/pkg/util/net*`, `helm/ovn-kubernetes/*`|Routing-table bounds, Helm wiring, IPv6 forwarding capability detection, and protocol-specific iptables policy handling are added.| |**Controller state and API consistency**
`go-controller/pkg/networkmanager/*`, `go-controller/pkg/util/pod*`, `go-controller/pkg/kube/*`, `go-controller/pkg/ovn/*`, `go-controller/pkg/metrics/*`|Advertisement preservation, live Pod retries, chassis cleanup, and certificate verification are updated.| |**Deployment feature flags**
`test/e2e/deploymentconfig/*`, `test/e2e/*`, `openshift/test/deploymentconfig/*`|Typed deployment flags control Layer 3 multi-subnet E2E behavior.| |**EgressIP validation coverage**
`test/e2e/egressip.go`|EgressIP and EgressFirewall tests use generated manifests, shared IP polling, stronger assignment checks, and managed-annotation failure cases.| |**KubeVirt and service validation**
`test/e2e/kubevirt.go`, `test/e2e/service.go`, `test/e2e/util.go`|Live-migration checks use iperf3 and cloud-init; MetalLB checks count distinct backend hostnames and obsolete rule helpers are removed.| |**Documentation and workload alignment**
`docs/*`, `contrib/perf/workloads/*`|Forwarding, routing-table, OKEP, DHCP IPAM, CRD, and network-policy documentation and templates are updated.| |**Review and test tooling**
`.coderabbit.yml`, `test/Makefile`, `test/scripts/e2e-cp.sh`, `openshift/go.mod`|Review enforcement, test argument quoting, test selection, and indirect module requirements are updated.| **Estimated code review effort:** 5 (Critical) | ~120 minutes **Possibly related PRs** - [openshift/ovn-kubernetes#3282](https://github.com/openshift/ovn-kubernetes/pull/3282): Implements overlapping deployment feature-flag and E2E CIDR-selection wiring. **Suggested labels:** `approved` **Suggested reviewers:** `jcaamano`, `kyrtapz`, `tssurya` **Poem** > I’m a rabbit who hops through the code, > Routing tables now carry their load. > IPv6 rules align, > E2E tests shine, > And merge bots obey every mode.
